$comment: Where the Zudocs prompts live in AirPrompter. Identifiers only: the Agent key, the staging run key and session tokens travel by environment or SSM (docs/PROMPTS.md, RUNBOOK.md). hostedRunUrl is the AgentRunUrl of AirPrompter's dev execution stack (hosted staging, D7); ciAgentId is the zudocs-ci Agent whose placeholder bundle is committed under vendored/.

canonical.$comment: The canonical dev pins the reset script advances from (reset means advance: a fresh generation from these, with the escalation summary's output cap bumped by one — a real change — then a second). Update when the owner re-authors a prompt.
